Each step file has a scoped `data-testid=guided-step-*` root which the previous monolith may or may not have had, but no listed testid is missing.
StepLocation now owns geoLoading locally (correct — parent no longer needs it). No cross-step coupling introduced.
GuidedChips.jsx correctly resets showAll on groupKey change via useEffect, matching the previous per-section '+N more' behavior.
